name: Klaus Ainhart
original_name: クラウス・アインハルト
source:
A young Navy officer whose body was possesses by Van Clad, the protagonist of this work.
His original personality was kind, diligent, hardworking and he was highly valued by others.
Van Clad, who possessed his body, uses the trust that Klaus had from his surroundings to manipulate the navy and the pirates as he plans to achieve vengeance.
